name: Shinonome Sayaka
source:
3rd year high school student.
The protagonist's friend since middle school.
She has a boyfriend, but she's a big fan of [url=/c50933]Ritsu[/url] and is a member of his unofficial fanclub.
A reliable 'Love Senior'.
